name: Communication
seo_title: UGC NET Paper 1 Communication Notes (Unit 4): Free, Topic-wise
description: Free UGC NET Paper 1 Communication notes: 11 topics, 90 sub-topics on models, types, verbal and non-verbal, classroom, barriers and mass media, with revision mode.
intro: Unit 4 usually carries about five questions (ten marks) and is theory-heavy rather than calculation-heavy, so it is one of the most scoring units. The notes follow the four official syllabus blocks: meaning and types, effective communication, barriers, and mass media. Each topic pairs a fact sheet (names, models, classifications) with a plain-language explanation and exam cues. Barriers, classroom communication and non-verbal communication are the most frequent question areas, so give them the most time.
how: Start at Topic 0 to see how the unit is tested, then go topic by topic in order. In each topic read the fact-sheet sections first, then the In simple words sections, which explain the same ideas with everyday examples.

Switch on Revision mode on any topic page to see the key terms, lists and tables without the explanations, plus the Memory Capsule. Learn every model as a pair: theorist and one-line tag (Berlo: SMCR, Hall: proxemics).
Use the rapid-recall sheet and Topic 10 (confusions to avoid, the keyword-to-answer cue sheet), then practise MCQs topic by topic.
